page_title: Turn your Mac Spaces into purpose-built Rooms.

sources.entry: CurrentKey - Add custom names and icons to Spaces and track app usage time. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/currentkey/id1456226992?mt=12)

summary.name: CurrentKey
summary.one_liner: CurrentKey is a Mac app that gives each macOS Space a custom name, icon, hotkey and banner ("Rooms") and tracks app usage time.
use_cases: Organize Mac Spaces by project or task
Quickly switch between workspaces via menubar or hotkeys
Track time spent in each app
Review daily and weekly usage charts
Share custom icon sets with others
summary.what_it_does: CurrentKey lets you turn macOS desktops (Spaces) into named Rooms with custom names, icons (hundreds built in, emoji, or your own), hotkeys and banners. You can jump between Rooms from the menubar or with hotkeys. It provides daily summaries, weekly comparisons and app-by-app usage charts. AppleScript can jump to a specific Room, react to Room changes, retrieve stats, or show a custom menu bar icon. Usage data stays on-device unless you export or generate reports.
notable: Rooms map names, icons and banners onto macOS Spaces without renaming Mission Control desktops
AppleScript hooks for jumping to Rooms, reacting to changes and pulling stats
Banners (including movies with sound) can appear in a screen corner on Room entry
Custom icons can be imported and exported to share
caveats: Does not rename Mission Control desktops; names exist only inside the app
Pricing is not stated on the page; it is listed on the Mac App Store
